observation_contract.validator: gg_price_assumptions.check_observations before unit conversion, for both Y and Z columns
observation_contract.observed_values: raw years and values must exactly match resolved registered observations; unobserved years are rejected
observation_contract.gender_contract: a series without gender dimensions supplies the same value to both Y and Z; gender/sex/성별 must match Y=남자 or Z=여자; gender-specific single-source observations are rejected because both columns are required
observation_contract.alternative_values: explicit price_sources registration with official schema and a different id; bundled id cannot be overridden
observation_contract.base_year: registered index basis; null for nominal currency series

rate_contract.observed_values: must match registered observations; cannot overwrite bundled observations
rate_contract.gender_contract: gender/sex/성별 of a wage series must match wage_male=남자 or wage_female=여자
